a salesman with pending offline orders when the admin locks the account: popup, Sign out keeps the replay token, pending work syncs through the allow-listed endpoints, "Some work could not be synced" note. Negative: an ordinary sign-out leaves no token and the rows are not replayed with a revoked session; a user who is not locked sees nothing.
old app with the new backend: unknown (TC_43). Old rows in the queue after upgrade: unknown, owner to confirm. Undo: next app release.

six new test files run by hand, 88 of 98 pass; the 10 failures are legacy
tests that fail the same on master [author]. The repo harness skips the full suite. TC sheet, QA sign-off (Android, iOS), test owner: unknown, owner to confirm.

merge resolution (headers and extraHeaders) relies on the author's run. Nitpicks: stale "could not be synced" note after 10 s; one test setting both header maps would pin the merge.
with a test salesman holding two queued orders, lock his designation and confirm the popup, Sign out, and that the orders reach the server after sign-in.
